verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe running GrowthBook on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose, including MongoDB, the API and the front-end, started with `docker compose up -d`. A self-hostable proxy is also documented. Community users independently confirm running the self-hosted version in production for months and describe GrowthBook as open source with an optional cloud offering. Missing for 10: production-grade deployment guidance beyond Docker Compose (e.g. scaling or upgrades), and clarity on which paid-tier features are available when self-hosted.
